summary: Listed in a 2016 table of Georgia lookout towers on Treat Mountain, Polk County; no history or site description found.

evidence.supports: Table row: Treat Mtn tower, Polk County, 1387 ft elevation, Georgia Forestry Commission number 718
The table was revised in March 2016

notes_for_editor: Stub. The only source is a 2016 table that places a tower on Treat Mountain and gives its coordinates, elevation and GFC number. It gives no build date, staffing, condition or access. Two web searches and fetches of the Wikipedia article (no Treat Mountain article at the URLs tried), the NHLR and FFLOS Georgia lists (Treat Mountain is on neither) found nothing on this tower. Fires on the mountain are on record but name no tower, so they are left out of the story: a 2016 Polk Standard Journal report (page read) of a 583-acre fire on Treat Mountain, reported by the Georgia Forestry Commission, and a 2026 Watch Duty listing (search snippet only) for a Polk Treat Mountain fire created by GFC on March 22, 2026. Editor decision needed: hold the stub until GFC tower records or Polk County historical sources are checked, or publish it as a short stub. The 2016 table is not proof the tower still stands. The table gives no unit label; feet is inferred from its values (the Brasstown row reads 4735, which only fits feet).
